snippet.title: Void Inc - Corporate Horror - DEMO Trailer
snippet.description:
I'm making a Corporate Survival Horror. 

You're head of Tech at Void Inc. Plan your day, survive minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure.

Try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

WISHLIST on Steam now, DEMO coming soon:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4889800/Void_Inc/
